candidate_visual_philosophy.statement: Create a quiet editorial field in which title, vessel, ingredients, whitespace and secondary information share optical responsibility instead of placing a headline over a product photograph.

candidate_stable_grammar.statement: Unequal title scale and placement form a spatial field balanced by a quieter side label, not a centered text box.
Whitespace separates roles and creates tension among title, still life and metadata; it is structural rather than empty.
A low tactile vessel-and-ingredient still life provides the optical anchor without becoming a centered finished-dish hero.
Secondary labels and tertiary prose create a quiet editorial cadence below and beside the primary field.
Type strokes, vessel silhouette, ingredient uprights and metadata axes share one optical geometry.

candidate_variation_axes.statement: The vessel, ingredients and title wording may change if their optical roles and calm material hierarchy remain intact.
Warm off-white and olive-black may shift within a restrained material palette without becoming promotional color blocking.

candidate_compatibility_constraints.statement: Requires a content set that supports vessel/ingredient still-life roles and enough copy hierarchy to form a true editorial page.

unresolved_contradictions.question: How much calligraphic energy can be removed before the family identity weakens?
Can a non-food still life preserve the same editorial geometry without becoming a generic lifestyle layout?
